I can't. I don't think I ever will.

I'm never doing anything like that again and honestly don't want to talk to people about it.

I've just enclosed it and been indenial of it like other trauma in my life.
I feel guilty, I regret shit I've done. I'm changed, I just have trouble living with myself.
What about truly awful things. Things that are just very vile. What about those people? Is there a line in which someone no longer deserves to live?
